reviews.text: 维持原判 勾八BUG实在是太多了 断腿bug 打着打着 角色减速了 也不知道为啥 暗影够狗 打架就搁哪里原地转圈 不知道的 还以为给我加油呢 拆障碍物 旁边的墙竟然不挡小怪 这个墙意义是什么？ 还有 打到快通关了 除了第一把枪还有狙击枪 后面的枪有什么用 够吧加特林一枪3点伤害 升级的资源完全不够 你必须还得重复刷前面的关卡 主要是一关怎么也得打20分钟 卧槽 你就刷吧 哪小飞虫你就打吧 这辈子有了
内容太少了，而且有飞虫存在对步枪很不友好，霰弹枪的弹药又太少了 建筑内容也太少了，建议学习一下誓死坚守。
对新手不友好，前期敌人血厚的要死，跑步又慢起码给个坐骑也好简直折磨

直接打了7个小时，说几点问题： 1.武器是多，但是大部分武器没什么用，碍于平面非3D画面，喷子子弹少，伤害高也是打1只，还要近身，所以喷子、机枪、冲锋枪直接下水道一桌，毫无意义，机枪移动速度惩罚迷惑。 所以前期没解锁狙击和左轮前，只需要升步枪即可，等狙击和左轮解锁了就用这两把，速度惩罚可以接受，能保持距离打，有准确度，能爆发，狙击能精准高伤害打击，可以直接用到第四张图。 2.这猎人和矿工捡东西太快，人物本身前后移动就有延迟惯性，每次让它吐出来没捡完又被别的猎人矿工捡了，又要浪费时间再操作。 3.然后这个游戏的优化有问题，无法设置帧数，妈的，老子5090D和98X3D，嗷嗷叫。 4.这个部分敌人的攻击特效有问题，第三个图居然就地面几个黄点移动过来就一刀，跟地面装饰素材重合的话初见必死。 第二个就是第四个图，毫无征兆闪一下人就无了，这种毫无攻击前兆的设置有什么乐趣？

框架玩法挺不错的，只是玩到后期有很多问题需要解决 1：在技能升级到5级后，大红球就没有用了，还占背包，建议有个储存设施或者可以和大蓝球替换，还有宝石也是，收集的部分宝石在局外升级完后也是没有用了，建议可以替换为其他颜色宝石，或者有个可以其他无限制消耗的地方 2：小蓝球过多，设施转换成大蓝球太慢，建议转换速度提升些，或者可以多建造设施 3：已经购买了4级塔却无法升级 4：工程师工作效率太慢，加速设施生产功能体现不明显，弹药运输也是，防御塔一直缺弹药却迟迟不补充 5：最后一个蜥蜴宠物一堆攻击技能就是不放，一直滚来滚去 6：基地地方太小，两个商店占太多地方了 7：小人职业祭坛无法储存工具，招募后还得亲自跑选择职业，建议更改成购买后储存工具，小人招募后自动专职 8：不像王国，动物在草坪和森林中随时刷新，而是一天一刷新，弓手射完后就没有事干了，导致除了挖矿，一天得到的大蓝球是固定的，有时还会减少，这严重拖慢了发育，而且也没有专门储存大蓝球的设施，建议更改下动物刷新机制。 9：缺乏群攻，远攻和防空手段，这是最严重的，游戏里防御设施只有迫击炮一种群攻手段，而且建设数量受限，占地面积较大，还及其容易打空浪费弹药，弹药容量还只有5发，面对怪海一会就打空了，升级也不加弹药容量，工程师无法及时补充。狙击手塔和机枪塔也是，升级后弹药用的很快，一会就需要补充，地图中部分怪物射程远，一直白嫖防御墙，狙击手塔无法及时解决，光打离基地近的怪物浪费伤害，还有空中怪物，因为弓手攻击方式是抛物线式的，导致射击空中怪物较为困难，狙击手塔还只能打一个，机枪塔还缺弹药，这些问题导致明明基地防御完备，一堆防御塔却被打穿，尤其是空中怪物，一来一堆，防御塔又无法及时处理完，常常有空中怪物冲死火堆的情况，因此，建议防御塔升级后增加弹药容量，增加其他功能，可以选择不同防御策略，例如机枪塔可以高优先级防空，升级近炸功能，狙击手塔可以高优先级攻击远程敌人，增加穿透， 10：玩家探索只能独自一个人，而野外一堆怪物，有时探索难度较高，没有升级时，弹药稀缺，无法开辟新的打猎地区，影响发育，建议可以更新旗帜功能，把职业小人利用起来，像王国80年代一样那样增加移动路障，后排部队输出功能，反推怪物基地功能 11：横板游戏，玩家在和怪物一样高度的情况下，枪械只能攻击最前面的怪物，枪械功能区别不明显，再加上榴弹枪，火箭筒能可以群攻或者穿透的武器攻击伤害不足，弹药类型不同导致无法携带大量弹药，在后期怪海，不同怪物混杂，攻击力高，速度快，体型小的情况下，处理特别费力。一个小地雷怪，埋在地里，你都不知道，直接踩了上去，还有闪光弹怪，也是速度快，体型小，你都没有看见，直接跑你脸上，白了全屏幕，还有远程攻击怪物一起攻击，再加上体力，弹药容量，即使升级后也是不太够用，出现打也打不过，跑也跑不了的情况。建议增加其他功能武器，例如防暴盾，无人机，喷火器，以及近战武器，其他武器增加穿透功能。 希望后续更新能解决这些问题
Love the game but its a bit dark (literally). It would be nice if we had more sunlight and less game-of-thrones-level-of-darkness. Anyway, thanks for the game!

王国爱好者不建议购入。 操作黏糊卡手，动作远大于策略，导致游戏流程又臭又长。优化也稀烂，玩个像素游戏风扇呼呼转。 另外，可以95%肯定地说，翻译使用了AI，浓浓的伪人感令人不适。

20260426 你这最后一把枪是加特林机炮，这个加特林机炮火力太差了，至少增强3-5倍的火力，否则对不起因为装备它而牺牲的移动速度。我甚至觉得加特林机炮的火力不如重机枪。 这游戏有一个建筑物是一个钻头，它向下挖地就能生产能量球，但是你这个建筑物首先不适合开局前期建造，因为生产效率太低远远不如弓箭手和矿工，然后你这个建筑物依然不适合后期出，因为这游戏后期根本不缺乏能量球，这个建筑物的生产效率低得不配当游戏后期的建筑物。所以这个建筑物存在的意义是什么？ 有一关叫“侦察留明空洞”，这一关的野生动物好像狩猎过以后第二天就不刷新了，难怪总是越玩越穷。 包括此后的关卡也是一样，野生动物都是只有第一天存在，第一天打猎完了第二天就不刷新了，难怪我怎么玩起来那么穷，老是缺光球的。这个游戏的第一关的野生动物不是能每天更新一次吗？怎么到了以后的关卡就不刷新了？光是采矿的钱根本不够花。 还有就是那个“拆废墟”元素简直是恶心得要死，就是让工人拆废墟，我和弓箭手守护工人。拆个废墟到底从天上和地上来的无数敌人冲过来黑压压的一片，我这里就我一个人拿着两把烂枪和两三个打人打不准的弓箭手NPC，我因为这个拆废墟的过程死了无数次，敌人完全是数不清的一群就冲过来，我背后就是废墟连拉扯的空间都没有，我要怎么防守？ 还有就是这个游戏里狙击枪塔和机枪塔需要玩家手动上弹药，但是这个上弹药的过程特难受，好像是第一次摁E是人物登上塔，再摁一次E就是补充子弹，在此期间鼠标还是不能晃动的，否则就无法补充弹药。而且这个机枪塔是不是用二级弹药？反正用一级弹药是无法补充弹药的，而图标是一级弹药。反正这个补充弹药的过程请优化一下，操作起来特别难受。

Overall I think the game is great. I only played about a couple hours into it and I think the concept is good, however, while playing it I did discover a bunch of bugs that made me stop playing immediately. Bugs: -Birds would freeze in the air before attacking my flame -Enemies would go through barricades even though I had full hp on the barricades -Hunter Banner flag would disappear and reappear in a distance after being picked up -Even though barricades were fixed enemies would still walk right through -I couldn't lose because enemies couldn't hit the flame and literally it was an immortal flame. If the devs could fix some of theses issues I'd gladly play again. But as for right now it needs polishing before you buy it.

Like Kingdoms, but trading some of the micro managing of your minions to shoot stuff yourself. Decent concept but bogged down by some un-fun design decisions. Art is nice. I didn't find it too confusing as some others did. World building is cool. Unlocks seems steady with new things to unlock each level. Aiming has a bit of rng with weapon sway, which never feels good. Especially when enemies have weak points you want to hit, but miss because of rng. Some enemies will deflect your bullets based on their animations, which is not something you can always play around, nor does it feel fun. Many, MANY flying enemies with tiny hitboxes, that when combined with weapon sway feel more annoying to fight than fun. Weapons in general don't feel very impactful nor fun to use without upgrades. Too many progression elements to the point where very basic things need to be unlocked or upgraded to be effective. For example, some weapons have basic stat upgrades like spread reduction and flat damage increases. So they introduced the problem of weapon sway/spread, then make you spend gems to fix it. Progression slows to a crawl pretty early on, with too few gems gained per level, and 5+ different upgradable things, and multiple levels of each upgradable thing on top of that (each weapon, each dog, base structure unlocks, structure upgrades, red orb shop upgrades, worker upgrades, etc.) You can go back to old levels to farm gems, but the amount is still low and the levels don't change. I had to do this a few times on just the 3rd level to get to a point where some things felt decent to use. Movement speed feels slow (even with upgrades) and levels can be pretty large. Teleporters help, but not really, since you still need to travel to and from them. Some elements are hard to interact with. Multiple times I had to repeatedly press E or retry holding E to interact with something. To determine worker range, you move a banner to determine their maximum range. But the banner mechanic for worker range just exasperates the slow movement speed problem, as you will be running back and forth to move the banner. Archers both hunt and act as ranged base defenders, but their accuracy is beyond terrible. They will miss slow moving targets, fast air targets, pretty much everything. Even with maxed out (100% lol, yet another upgradeable stat) accuracy. You can't manually control where your defenders go during the night. So sometimes one side will have 6 stationed archers with nothing to attack, while the other side has a maxed out raid incoming. Days are short and dusk is short as well. Leaving not a whole lot of leeway between trying to get objectives/gems, and defending your base. The whole flow of the game seems broken. For example. You only get upgrade gems by opening boxes, which you get to by exploring the map. Very often I'd be out pushing towards one end of the map, when dusk would hit. I'd stop what I'm doing to run back to base, which took the majority of dusk time to do (with stamina/run speed upgrades btw). Once at base I'd have to run between my minions, some of which are in towers at opposite ends of the base, to gather the orbs they've collected. With an upgraded camp, some of these minions can be in towers far out of the campfire's light range. By this time dusk is done and enemies start spawning. I've barely had time to upgrade barricades, restock ammo, or anything; and can't now because you can't upgrade things with enemies nearby. The situation that made me crash out was a part with rubble blocking your path; that you need to assign miners to clear, and you need to defend them while they do. The issue was that even with the max amount of miners, they took all day to clear the rubble, and your archers come defend them as well. Meaning no orbs were being produced. During this event, the game spawned an entire flock of air enemies that swooped down, making my archers run back. But because the area to defend is small, the archer Ai is to run if enemies are close, and the enemies don't move back, my archers stood against the rubble doing nothing. Leaving me to shoot all the air and ground enemies myself. Then dusk hit, and all my workers immediately stopped doing what they were doing (nothing) and went back into the teleporter to base. At base there was very little I could do. I had very few orbs because most of my miners and archers were occupied clearing the rubble. Now the icing on the cake is, this might not have been a problem, except the radar told me the entire horde was coming from the left side. Problem was, I had towers set up on the right side that the majority of my archers automatically took hold in. I have no way of telling them to get out of the right side towers so they could help defend the left, so half of my defenders were useless. Maybe there's an upgrade to fix that issue, but if there is, it shouldn't be an upgrade. All in all, its just not fun. Combat doesnt feel fun because of intense ammo managment and rng sway. Building doesn't feel fun because of limited options and wonky interact detection. Progression isn't fun because there are too many things to upgrade with too few gems gained per level.

Generally speaking, there is so much [b]potential[/b] but at the same time, so much drawback about this game. Let start with the good part about the game. 1) The OST and art design are pretty good. Its not the best OST where its game breaking but it does fit well with the theme. The art is good enough to distinguish what is an enemy, what is a friend, what guns and what companion you have. 2) The game mechanics is pretty simple. Shoot, reload, craft. A simple tower defense. Additionally a huge rarity of enemies. Some small little f*ckers like the flies that requires precise aim while large tanks that comes to your base to smash. 3) The game is buggy for achievements. Some works, some doesnt but so far, I havent seen any game breaking bugs Now the drawbacks 1) The campaign / story is disappointing. There isnt anything [b]leading[/b] up to a huge finale. It's just "do this and do that and after that, go here and go there to finish your campaign". There wasnt anything like some mystical crystal that saves the world or any ancient civilization or stuffs like that. It really is just point A to point B with getting guns and upgrading along the way 2) The price tag..... $20, imo is a bit tad expensive for something that after you are done with the campaign, you only have horde mode ( endless mode ). TBH, one could just finish the game in 6 hrs if you know what to do and after that, there isnt anything else the game has to offer. There are no co-op, there are no special missions, there are no challenge missions. Basically its just that..... One could argue that the game just recently release so I am expecting too much. Thats fine but then again, the game could have release for a cheaper price and then sell the DLC either seperately or marked it higher like other games ( an example is Factorio ). You are paying essentially for [b]two things, campaign and endless mode[/b]. All in all, a 6.5/10. Alright but disappointing. Get it during sale if you want to. If there is DLC and its offer for free, then it could justified the price tag but again, at the moment, it doesnt have much to offer

A resemblance to Kingdom's Saga, but with, I belive, way less playtesting. This led to a lot of unbalanced mechanics that can hardly be reconciled by the overarching narrative. In general, the gameplay is interesting for the first 2 hours, but later it becomes a chore to do anything since everything relies on your character while your troops are almost useless. The meta-progression is extremely long-lived but has hardly any purpose outside of the neat character and weapon upgrades.
A challenging entry into the genre.

The Ember Guardian 7/10 It's a fun game, similar to another game that shall not be mentioned (( 🏰 👑👑)), HOWEVER the difference comes with personal weapons, your companion, the upgrading system to your base, the moving of buildings for your base, and the story. I love the aspect of moving your own buildings, having guns was also fun mechanic. The only enemy that I can consider extremely annoying. Shield gunner, and wizard. The gunner is slightly annoying with having to shoot him in the head, and the wizard shoots just far enough that if you don't have towers ready he can take out your walls. The small creatures are extremely hard to hit, anyway to make their hitbox a little bigger? I feel like luke shooting the death star when they are running at me. The guns: a lot of weaponry can be fun but if they aren't properly made correctly it takes the fun out of them... The AA launcher and the grenade launcher should do a little more Bang than just sounding of Boom... Your revolver and sniper should do anti armor for those annoying shields. Your dragon companion should be more aggressive since he isn't digging or fetching, increase the attack rate. Speaking of companions, your dog should do a better job of alerting you to an ambush instead of letting you know while it's happening... Have them fart or something in the area ahead to let the player know "hey there's something wrong up there." Before the ambush, I thought that was one of the abilities and still, would get jumped and the dog was like 🤷 The story. It's great, however I noticed during some parts if you didn't do it correctly, it would glitch out. Talking to someone in the open world before you were directed to can kinda mess up the game, resulting in restarting the level. Overall it's a fun game, replayability is 💯% where you can play levels over and over. If there was anything I would add, a blessed cursed salesman, sells some interesting items that might make the game more fun but challenging. During one round, meaning you have to spend special rainbow gems (basically one of each to make a rainbow gem) you can buy items that affect the game: Want more diamonds and gems? 5% increased enemies and stronger from both sides. Want more orbs? Or workers? Your third night has a larger wave from one side for one night. Increased health and ammo regen? More enemies roam the lands / increased chances of ambush. You get the idea. Super fun game tho. 👍

This is easily the coolest-looking tower defense game I've ever played! In fact, it's more than just a tower defense game. The atmosphere and ambiance it creates are just beautiful, and the music enhances it all. The storytelling makes the game fun, too. There's always something new to explore. This game has so much more to offer in a unique and interesting way. If you have some money to spare, I highly recommend playing this game. The devs deserve all the love and support they can get.
Really engaging and fun game based on the Kingdoms formula but with loads of extra bits and tons of customisation. Highly recommended to anyone who is a fan of tower defence.

目前只想给个中评，游戏潜力还是很大的 看似技能多，武器多，实际好用的就那么一两个 武器推荐：初始步枪开蓄力模式，再搭配被动技能夜间猎人（不开灯就是常驻增伤50%）足以一枪秒，副武器只推荐裸突击步枪，后期一堆小篮球就靠突击步枪清（自带子弹小吸附） 科技树推荐：优先点每天早上自动来2火灵（一是不用浪费跑图时间去招募，二是相当于每天省2白球，前期收益巨大），防御塔等级和木箱等级（满级箱子修复也是一白球），猎人优先攻击和命中率，后补攻速。以及开局随机给等级3的被动技能（开局刷红球掉落UP） 大技能推荐：死神降临，5级115攻击的AOE，火灵狂暴+自己所有单位的攻速，晚上开一个就是剑雨洗地，另外在锄墙开路的时候也能加旷工的速度 被动技能推荐：T0小怪掉落UP（开局优先刷，影响一整局的技能升级速度），T1夜间猎人（满级常驻的50%增伤，步枪和狙击枪单发高伤的大爹），T2跑速类，回血回弹 布局推荐：1本箱左右猎人塔，2本箱左右猎人塔，足以杀穿主线，主角站中间开狂暴都能吃到 以下是希望游戏制作组改进的地方 ①武器只需要小弹药，重武器类可以改成消耗更多的小子弹，因为弹药台如果你做重武器子弹，那么晚上大概率狙击塔和机枪塔是没子弹的 ②各类制造台提取机制，建议改成做完一组就可以提取，而目前是一定要做完3组队列才能全部提取，明明弹药都做好了，而你只能等做完才能取出，纯恶心人 ③后期大红球严重溢出，是的，大红球非常容易溢出，大技能都点满了，大红球存储箱满了，包里的塞的多还没其他地方可以用还会顶飞白球，扔都麻烦，建议存储箱无上限或者转化成小红球。而小红球是所有资源里最难获取的，两个主动技能5级，小技能可能都点不满一个，建议增加一下掉率，主角局内爽感全靠小技能被动提升 ④增加宝石背包上限和掉率

Had a good time playing this for the first ten or so hours - as a big Kingdoms fan, this is pretty close to being able to do what a lot of people have wanted which is fighting against the enmies instead of hiding behind the towers and walls. The downside? It's a slog to collect gems for upgrades. The last eight hours has been grinding previously beaten maps just to unlock gem chests and get back to the base to continue unlocks. Started to do this because the final boss was pretty difficult without the upgrades and trashed the fire really quickly. If the gem amount was bumped up and the gem base increased in size, this would be a great 20 hour long game with some decent replability for endless mode. Wouldn't recommend it unless you really like grinding.

Its surprisingly fun. Just when you think you've figured it out, it adds another element. There's thing i wish were changed to be my perfect game, but i won't really complain. Game runs great, no bugs in my first 12 hours. Im taking my time and not rushing to the end. I'd recommend it

As most others, I am also a huge fan of the Kingdom series. This game is challenging, and is about resource management. Like Kingdom, you need to go back to other levels sometimes and farm for gems to upgrade your base/equipment, but it definitely didn't feel like a "slog" as others have mentioned. Every upgrade made replays feel a little bit different, and they also went much faster which was appealing. I could see my progress and I truly enjoyed every bit of it. The only issue that I experienced is that the dog is a bit glitchy and disappears sometimes but when you whistle he usually resets and comes back okay.

I enjoy this game on my PC. But there is no logical explanation on why it runs so poorly on a Steam Deck. Kingdom runs great, and they are comparable in graphical quality. The moment it rains in this game, the frame rate plummets into the depths. It’s a 2D, retro pixel art game and the Steam Deck, which can run Elden Ring to a certain degree, can certainly handle this game. Fix this and we are good to go.
